# Hearth UI

> Themeable Vue and web components for self-hosted dashboards, public pages, and authentication. Start here, then read only the component references needed for the task.

This index covers 70 public components in source version 0.5.0. The working tree may contain unpublished changes. Check package versions and registry/release availability before assuming a new feature is published.

## Agent workflow

1. Choose the native Vue or web-component distribution for the host framework. Reuse existing Hearth components.
2. Choose a frame: [HPublicShell](docs/components/public-shell/llms.txt), [HAuthPage](docs/components/auth-page/llms.txt), or [HDashboardShell](docs/components/dashboard-shell/llms.txt).
3. Read [HTheme](docs/components/theme/llms.txt) before changing palettes, tokens, or density.
4. Follow the component links for props, defaults, events, slots, recipes, and constraints. Do not invent APIs.
5. Keep authentication, authorization, routing, requests, and persistence in the application.
6. After editing repository APIs, run `npm run docs:generate` and `npm run docs:check`.

## Packages and entry points

- Native Vue: `@hearth-ui/vue`. Import named components and `@hearth-ui/vue/styles.css`. Vue 3.5+ is a peer dependency; this build does not bundle Vue.
- Web components: `@hearth-ui/elements`. Import `registerElements` from its root and load `@hearth-ui/elements/themes.css`. No Vue dependency or Vue types are required by the host.
- Auto-registration: `@hearth-ui/elements/auto`. Custom prefixes use `registerElements('my-app')`.
- Both packages export theme helpers/types and include these references. Install from npm after publication, or use tarballs from `npm run pack:packages` / [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/releases). Do not assume a prepared package is already on npm.
- Raw HTML: extract the elements package, link `dist/themes.css`, and load `dist/elements/auto.js` as a module. Keep shared chunks together. No Node globals or global Vue are required.
- Native Vue supports SSR. Custom elements render when connected in the browser; declarative shadow-DOM hydration is not provided.
- The repository root is a private build workspace, not a publishable UI package. Earlier `@samishal1998/hearth-ui` release artifacts were a combined distribution; use matching version documentation when maintaining those installs.

## Shared integration rules

- Vue props use camelCase; HTML attributes use kebab-case. Array/object values are DOM properties, never JSON attributes.
- Boolean attributes use presence/absence. Assign `element.disabled = false`, not `disabled="false"`.
- Custom events emitted by Vue use argument arrays: `const [value] = event.detail`. Listen on the element; do not assume bubbling. Native `click` remains a MouseEvent.
- Vue uses `v-model` or a documented named model. Apply consumer-owned state changes for favorite, close, and navigation events.
- Vue named slots use `#name`; native slots use `slot="name"`. Web components have no scoped slots.
- Named fields join their owning form through ElementInternals. Multi-selects submit repeated values: read `FormData.getAll(name)`.
- Keep forms and field hosts in one DOM tree. Set initial properties before connection for reset defaults. Do not put unrelated fields into an auth page's non-form slots.
- `formDisabled` and `control-sync` are internal plumbing, not application APIs.
- Source palettes: `sunset`, `ocean`, `forest`, `dusk`, `rose`. Sunset is default. Modes: dark, light, system. Densities: comfortable, compact.
- Prefer inherited `--h-*` variables, then exposed CSS parts. Do not patch shadow-root implementation DOM.
- Use visible labels, state text, and native keyboard behavior. Verify your custom palette and complete application, not just isolated components.

## Quick component selection

- Fixed choice: HSelect. Searchable choice: HCombobox. Array-only searchable choice: HMultiSelect. Visible exclusive choices: HRadioGroup.
- Selection/agreement: HCheckbox. On/off setting: HSwitch. Text: HInput/HTextarea. Numeric adjustment: HRange.
- Panels: HTabs. Expandable sections: HAccordion. Routes: HNavigationMenu/HSidebar/HBreadcrumbs.
- Work progress: HProgress. Loading shapes: HSkeleton. Empty results: HEmptyState. Feedback: HAlert. State label: HBadge.
- Content: HCard. App launcher: HAppCard. Metric: HStatCard.

## Layouts

- [HAuthPage](docs/components/auth-page/llms.txt): The full split-screen welcome/login page. It emits credentials; your application owns authentication.
- [HBreadcrumbs](docs/components/breadcrumbs/llms.txt): A wrapping breadcrumb trail with an accessible current page.
- [HDashboardShell](docs/components/dashboard-shell/llms.txt): A complete dashboard frame with desktop sidebar, native mobile navigation dialog, account controls, and content area.
- [HErrorPage](docs/components/error-page/llms.txt): Not-found, access-denied, and unavailable page treatments with clear recovery actions.
- [HFirstRunSetup](docs/components/first-run-setup/llms.txt): An application-controlled owner-account, provider, and completion setup recipe.
- [HNavigationMenu](docs/components/navigation-menu/llms.txt): A navigation disclosure menu with native links, nested groups, outside-click dismissal, and Escape support.
- [HPageHeader](docs/components/page-header/llms.txt): A plain page introduction or the signature atmospheric dashboard hero.
- [HProviderSetup](docs/components/provider-setup/llms.txt): A connection setup recipe with required fields, test/save requests, and connection feedback.
- [HPublicShell](docs/components/public-shell/llms.txt): A public landing-page frame: brand, a few links, an account action, and a quiet footer.
- [HResourceDetail](docs/components/resource-detail/llms.txt): A resource introduction with breadcrumbs, state, metadata, and tabbed details.
- [HSettingsPage](docs/components/settings-page/llms.txt): Grouped settings content with dirty-state feedback and save/reset requests.
- [HSidebar](docs/components/sidebar/llms.txt): A standalone, collapsible sidebar with grouped navigation and optional custom header/footer.
- [HStatusPage](docs/components/status-page/llms.txt): A public status-page recipe with service groups, derived summary, and incident updates.
- [HStepper](docs/components/stepper/llms.txt): An ordered workflow indicator with optional step selection and completed or unavailable states.

## Controls

- [HAccordion](docs/components/accordion/llms.txt): Native details/summary disclosures with single or multiple expansion.
- [HButton](docs/components/button/llms.txt): Native button or link behavior, clear focus, icon-only labels, and restrained press feedback.
- [HButtonBar](docs/components/button-bar/llms.txt): Group actions without changing native button focus or submission behavior.
- [HCalendar](docs/components/calendar/llms.txt): A keyboard-navigable Gregorian month calendar with date-only values, bounds, and unavailable days.
- [HCheckbox](docs/components/checkbox/llms.txt): A native checkbox with a mixed-state option and optional description.
- [HChip](docs/components/chip/llms.txt): A compact selectable or removable label with distinct toggle and remove actions.
- [HChipGroup](docs/components/chip-group/llms.txt): An array-valued filter group or removable set of selected tags.
- [HCombobox](docs/components/combobox/llms.txt): Searchable single or multi-select with selected chips, disabled options, keyboard navigation, and repeated form values.
- [HCommandPalette](docs/components/command-palette/llms.txt): A searchable keyboard command dialog with grouping, shortcuts, and disabled commands.
- [HCopyField](docs/components/copy-field/llms.txt): A read-only endpoint, identifier, or secret field with explicit clipboard and reveal actions.
- [HDatePicker](docs/components/date-picker/llms.txt): A native date field with a keyboard-operated calendar popover.
- [HDateRangePicker](docs/components/date-range-picker/llms.txt): Two date pickers with start/end constraints and native form validation.
- [HDropdownMenu](docs/components/dropdown-menu/llms.txt): A keyboard-operated command menu for edit, copy, refresh, and destructive actions.
- [HFileUpload](docs/components/file-upload/llms.txt): Native file selection and drag/drop with configurable validation, file lists, and application-owned progress.
- [HInput](docs/components/input/llms.txt): A labeled input with help/error text and native validation. Web components participate in their owning form.
- [HMultiSelect](docs/components/multi-select/llms.txt): An array-typed multi-select combobox using the same searchable selection engine as HCombobox.
- [HNumberInput](docs/components/number-input/llms.txt): A numeric field and counter with native stepping, bounds, validation, and an explicit empty value.
- [HPagination](docs/components/pagination/llms.txt): Bounded page navigation with current-page semantics and ellipses for long lists.
- [HPopover](docs/components/popover/llms.txt): A nonmodal top-layer panel anchored to its trigger, with viewport-aware positioning and focus handling.
- [HRadioGroup](docs/components/radio-group/llms.txt): One native radio group per component, with descriptions, disabled choices, and arrow/Home/End keyboard control.
- [HRange](docs/components/range/llms.txt): A native numeric slider with a visible value and optional unit.
- [HRangeSlider](docs/components/range-slider/llms.txt): Two native range handles for choosing a bounded numeric interval.
- [HSegmentedControl](docs/components/segmented-control/llms.txt): A compact exclusive-value selector backed by the shared native radio-group engine.
- [HSelect](docs/components/select/llms.txt): A native select with labeled options, not a recreated browser picker.
- [HSwitch](docs/components/switch/llms.txt): A keyboard-operable switch backed by a real checkbox, with form participation in custom-element mode.
- [HTabs](docs/components/tabs/llms.txt): Tabs with roving focus, arrow/Home/End keys, and properly associated panels.
- [HTextarea](docs/components/textarea/llms.txt): A labeled multiline field with native constraints and form reset support.
- [HThemeSwitcher](docs/components/theme-switcher/llms.txt): A light, dark, and system preference selector. Bind its value to HTheme mode.
- [HTimePicker](docs/components/time-picker/llms.txt): Native time entry with bounds and a configurable step in seconds.

## Surfaces

- [HAppCard](docs/components/app-card/llms.txt): A launchable application card with source, status, and optional owner controls. Favorite state belongs to your app.
- [HCard](docs/components/card/llms.txt): The common surface: restrained depth, a readable heading, and generous space for your content.
- [HCodeBlock](docs/components/code-block/llms.txt): Escaped, copyable code or configuration text with optional wrapping and line numbers.
- [HDataTable](docs/components/data-table/llms.txt): Semantic data tables with sorting, selection, paging, loading/empty states, and row actions.
- [HDescriptionList](docs/components/description-list/llms.txt): Responsive native key/value metadata with links and per-value slots.
- [HList](docs/components/list/llms.txt): A semantic list container for integrations, activity, and settings rows.
- [HListItem](docs/components/list-item/llms.txt): A readable row with icon, description, badge, and separate action content.
- [HLogViewer](docs/components/log-viewer/llms.txt): A bounded log tail with search, level filtering, pause/follow controls, and copy support.
- [HSeparator](docs/components/separator/llms.txt): A structural divider, optionally labeled or exposed as an accessible separator.
- [HSparkline](docs/components/sparkline/llms.txt): A small SVG trend with a textual summary, finite-data handling, and semantic tones.
- [HStatCard](docs/components/stat-card/llms.txt): A quiet overview metric with tabular numbers, an icon, and a supporting label.
- [HTimeline](docs/components/timeline/llms.txt): An ordered activity history for deployments, audit events, and incident updates, with timestamps and per-event detail slots.

## Feedback

- [HAlert](docs/components/alert/llms.txt): Inline feedback for success, information, and problems. Errors announce as alerts; other tones use status.
- [HBadge](docs/components/badge/llms.txt): A compact label with optional status dot. Color always accompanies text.
- [HConnectionState](docs/components/connection-state/llms.txt): Connection lifecycle feedback with an optional application-owned retry action.
- [HDialog](docs/components/dialog/llms.txt): A native modal dialog with focus containment, Escape dismissal, and focus return. Keep it inside your theme island.
- [HEmptyState](docs/components/empty-state/llms.txt): An inviting first-run or no-results state, with room for a useful next action.
- [HProgress](docs/components/progress/llms.txt): Native determinate or indeterminate progress, with percentage text and semantic colors.
- [HSheet](docs/components/sheet/llms.txt): A native modal side panel for inspection and editing without leaving the current page.
- [HSkeleton](docs/components/skeleton/llms.txt): Text, rectangle, and circular loading placeholders with reduced-motion support.
- [HToast](docs/components/toast/llms.txt): A dismissible notification with optional action, a timer, and pause-on-hover/focus behavior.
- [HToaster](docs/components/toaster/llms.txt): A controlled, positioned notification stack that composes HToast.
- [HTooltip](docs/components/tooltip/llms.txt): Hoverable, keyboard-accessible help text with a configurable delay and Escape dismissal.

## Foundation

- [HAvatar](docs/components/avatar/llms.txt): An image avatar with initials fallback and an optional decorative mode.
- [HBrand](docs/components/brand/llms.txt): A text wordmark with the signature accent. Use your own name, optional logo, and tagline.
- [HIcon](docs/components/icon/llms.txt): A small, consistent supporting icon set. Decorative by default; put the accessible label on its control.
- [HTheme](docs/components/theme/llms.txt): A scoped theme island. CSS variables flow through Vue trees, native slots, and shadow roots.
